record_audits.database_subject: Cesin, a short natural variant of nisin, displays potent antimicrobial activity against major pathogens despite lacking two C-terminal macrocycles.
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (72%) to Rombocin A Activity: Active against L. lactis MG1363 (MIC 0.08 ug/ml), L. monocytogenes LMG10470 or TT82E or LK132 (MIC 2.56-10.25 ug/ml), B. cereus CH-85 (MIC 20.5 ug/ml), S. aureus LMG10147 or LMG15975 MRSA (MIC 5.13 ug/ml), E. faecium LMG11423 or LMG16003 anti-VRE (MIC 5.13-10.25 ug/ml), E. faecalis LMG16216 VRE (MIC 5.13 ug/ml), C. perfringens CECT376 (MIC 0.5 ug/ml), and C-difficile CECT531 (MIC >31.5 ug/ml). SAR: Despite lacking rings D and E, cesin demonstrates broad antimicrobial activity against Gram+ bacteria comparable to nisin Z. Recombinant production:bacteria:Lactococcus lactis: expressedx using the nisin-controlled gene expression system. MOA:bacteria:L. lactis MG1363: it binds to lipid II and lipoteichoic acid (LTA). Unable to form a pore on the membrane. Est.2/2024
